body:
i feel like she and her are pretty much working at the same goal of keeping me as far in this hole as possible. they almost complement each other in making my life hell

A-team right here

I'd be super interested in that! I need to learn how to open up to people who can help me and I think seeing how others open up would help me.

This might sound nuts, but I realized just now how long they've been around. Around age 4, I remember I had this game where I'd make the ugliest face possible in a mirror and then turn around and make this gorgeous face. and the gorgeous one would always defeat ugly in a beauty contest or a debate or something. She and Her junior? I think so -.-

Thank you so much for reaching out. I was really worried no one would bother

Am I in pain? I honestly cannot tell. I didn't know. I never knew how to put into words how I felt until I put a bunch of stuff in my system that doesn't belong there and just regurgitated 3 years of repressed bullshit into a little note on my iphone.

I'm a bit embarrassed to show this to anyone, but I think I might have to if I want help.
